outcome: Changes now reach the live Lab only through green pull requests
owner_impact: Nothing changes in how the Lab looks or behaves. From now on no agent can push a change straight to the live Lab: every change must go through a pull request whose checks (tests, build and the browser check before publishing) are green, and GitHub itself refuses anything else. Documentation-only pull requests also run the checks so they can always be merged. 'Done means verified live' is unchanged: a green pull request is never the finish line, only the green live run of the merged version is.

next.text: Next is #537 — simulator core tidy-up: standard formatting, removal of harmless warnings and of an unusual file-inclusion trick in the Rust simulator, with the recorded reference runs proving that not a single number changes. #537 has not started.
